title: CRM Manager - Braze
description:
Job Tittle: CRM Manager
Location: Belfast, Birmingham, Bristol, Chester, Edinburgh, Halifax, Leeds, London or Manchester
Contract: 6 Months - possibility for extension
Job Type: Full-time
Working Pattern: Hybrid - at least 2 days per week in the office
Rate: Circa 350/Day

About the Role

We're looking for an experienced CRM Manager to drive customer engagement, retention and loyalty across UK and EEA markets.

These roles will support the delivery of high-volume, multi-channel CRM campaigns and help maintain continuity across marketing and customer service communications

In this role, you'll design, deliver and optimise multi-channel marketing campaigns, using customer data and insights to create personalised experiences throughout the customer journey.

What We're Looking For
- Hands-on Braze experience in CRM campaign management is essential
- Proven experience delivering CRM campaigns end to end across multiple communication channels.
- Background in fintech, e-commerce or direct-to-consumer businesses is essential
- Strong analytical skills and experience evaluating campaign performance.
- Ability to create reports, interpret data and recommend improvements using Excel or Google Sheets.
- Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills.
- Experience managing multiple campaigns in a high-volume environment.
- Ability to work independently, take ownership and deliver results with limited guidance.

Key Responsibilities
- Own the end-to-end delivery of multi-channel CRM campaigns across email, push notifications, in-app messaging and SMS.
- Manage multiple campaigns and initiatives simultaneously in a fast-paced environment.
- Use Braze to support CRM campaign management and execution.
- Analyse campaign performance and historical data to identify trends, opportunities and areas for improvement.
- Produce and interpret campaign reports using Excel or Google Sheets.
- Recommend actionable optimisation strategies based on campaign insights.
- Collaborate with Product, Growth and other stakeholders.
- Support new feature launches and customer communications.
- Contribute to the wider CRM strategy and continuously improve campaign effectiveness.

Why Join?

Join a pioneering, fast-changing financial services business that is shaping finance as a force for good. This is an exciting opportunity to make a real impact by improving customer experiences, driving engagement and building effective retention strategies.

You'll work collaboratively with Growth, Product and Data teams, using customer insights, innovative CRM tools and data-driven marketing strategies to deliver meaningful results. If you're looking for an opportunity to develop your expertise, influence customer lifecycle strategies and contribute to a growing business, this role could be the perfect fit.

title: Digital Marketing Account Executive
description:
We re looking for a Digital Marketing Account Executive to join a fun, energetic and genuinely supportive team.

You ll work with a varied portfolio of clients, managing their day-to-day digital marketing activity across SEO, PPC, paid advertising and social media. From understanding client objectives and coordinating campaign delivery to reviewing performance and identifying opportunities for growth, you ll play a key role in helping clients get the best from their marketing.

This is a great opportunity for someone who enjoys the variety of agency life, building strong client relationships and working closely with specialists across different disciplines, with plenty of scope to develop their skills and progress their career.

The Role

You ll manage a portfolio of clients across a range of industries, helping them get the most from their digital marketing activity. No two days will be the same, with plenty of variety, collaboration and opportunities to make a real difference to your clients success.

Your responsibilities will include
- Managing relationships with multiple clients and acting as their main point of contact.
- Coordinating digital marketing campaigns across SEO, PPC, paid advertising and social media.
- Working closely with internal specialists to plan, deliver and optimise campaigns.
- Monitoring performance, analysing results whilst identifying opportunities for growth.
- Keeping clients informed, managing expectations and ensuring campaigns stay on track.
- Spotting opportunities to improve results and grow existing client accounts.

Experience and Skills
- Previous experience working within a fast-paced digital marketing agency is essential.
- Experience managing multiple client accounts and competing priorities.
- A good understanding of digital marketing channels, including SEO, PPC, paid ads and social media.
- Strong communication and relationship-building skills.
- Excellent organisation, with the ability to keep on top of deadlines and changing priorities.
- A proactive, positive approach and the confidence to get stuck in.

You ll be joining a team that genuinely enjoys what they do and supports one another along the way.
- A friendly and welcoming working environment.
- Flexible working hours to help you find a routine that works for you.
- Plenty of opportunities to learn, develop and progress your career.
- Exposure to a varied client base and a broad range of digital marketing campaigns.
- A collaborative team where your ideas are welcomed and your development matters

This role is immediately avavible for the right person.

- Liaising with external agencies and internal teams to ensure campaigns are delivered effectively and on time

Applicants must have previous solid experience within a digital marketing role and, importantly, be able to demonstrate campaign delivery rather than experience in just one area of marketing. You will have:
- Experience delivering end to end marketing campaigns

- Experience working with external agencies
- Strong copywriting and content skills
- Confidence collating campaign data and reporting on results

- The confidence to work collaboratively across different teams

title: Digital Marketing Executive
description:
Do you have hands-on experience in SEO and PPC and enjoy seeing the direct impact of your digital marketing activity on business growth?

Are you a well-rounded digital marketer who can confidently manage websites, email campaigns, social media, and digital performance across multiple channels?

If you can answer yes to the above questions, then this could be the PERFECT role for you!

Reed Marketing & Creative are currently working with a growing and well-established business that is looking to recruit a Digital Marketing Executive to join its marketing team. This is an exciting opportunity for a proactive and commercially minded marketer to take ownership of SEO and PPC activity, helping to bring key digital marketing functions in-house while supporting wider marketing initiatives across the business.

This role would suit someone who enjoys variety, is confident working autonomously, and is looking for a position where they can have a genuine impact on marketing performance and business growth.

Key Responsibilities:
- Manage and optimise SEO activity to improve website visibility, organic traffic, and search rankings.
- Oversee PPC campaigns, monitoring performance and identifying opportunities to improve ROI and lead generation.
- Work closely with external agencies and internal stakeholders to ensure digital marketing objectives are achieved.

- Have experience using tools such as Google Analytics, Google Ads, Search Console and email marketing platforms.
- Demonstrate strong knowledge of website management, social media and content marketing.
- Be comfortable analysing campaign performance and using data to make informed decisions.

A competitive salary, ongoing training and development, the opportunity to take ownership of key digital marketing channels, and the chance to join a growing business where your work will have a visible impact on marketing performance and commercial success.

If you are keen to know more about this fantastic opportunity as a Digital Marketing Executive, please click on the link to apply! Alternatively, you can get in touch with Bianca Halliburton at Reed Marketing & Creative in Reading.

£32,000 - £40,000

VIQU have partnered with a well-established brand who are looking for an experienced and commercially minded E-commerce Specialist to oversee and develop our growing online sales operations. title: Marketing Manager
description:
Marketing Manager

Birmingham area

Hybrid working

c£40,000 - £50,000 DOE

This is an exciting, newly created Marketing Manager role joining a successful, established business with exciting and ambitious plans for growth.

As part of a newly formed Marketing, Digital and E-commerce team, you'll take ownership of marketing for a growing, multi-site B2 B and B2 C supplier. It's a broad, hands-on role covering everything from promotional campaigns and new site launches to CRM, email, social media, print and customer acquisition.

There's plenty of autonomy. You'll be encouraged to bring ideas to the table, challenge how things are done and really make your mark, while working closely with an approachable, down-to-earth Marketing Director and a talented team of marketing, digital and e-commerce peers.

The department is also embracing AI in a big way. You might already be highly skilled in modern AI marketing tools, automation and workflows, or you may have a good grounding and be excited by the opportunity to develop this further. Either way, curiosity and a genuine interest in how AI can make marketing smarter, faster and more effective will be important.

The role

You'll take ownership of a varied marketing plan supporting multiple business locations and online channels. Your remit will include:
- Planning and delivering promotional, seasonal and commercially focused marketing campaigns.
- Supporting new site openings and local marketing initiatives.
- Managing email, CRM, customer retention and reactivation campaigns.
- Overseeing organic social content and local demand generation.
- Managing brochures, leaflets, POS and other print activity from brief through to delivery.
- Working closely with operational and sales teams to understand customers and what drives sales.
- Tracking campaign performance, budgets, leads and commercial results.
- Using AI and automation tools to streamline marketing activity, improve efficiency and increase output.

This isn't a role where you'll spend all week sitting behind a desk. You'll regularly visit different business locations, engage with the people closest to the customer and use those insights to shape marketing activity.

What we're looking for

You'll be a commercially minded, hands-on marketer who enjoys taking ownership, delivering results and getting things done.

You'll bring:
- Experience in a broad marketing role, within a multi-site trade, retail, merchant or similar commercially driven environment.
- A good understanding of B2 B and B2 C marketing, customer acquisition and retention.
- Practical experience across a mix of CRM/email marketing, campaigns, social media, print and local marketing.
- Confidence interpreting marketing data, measuring performance and understanding commercial impact.
- Experience using modern marketing platforms and technology, with an interest in developing your AI and automation capabilities.
- A proactive, organised and self-sufficient approach, with strong communication skills and attention to detail.

What's on offer?

You'll be joining a growing team where there's real scope to influence how the marketing function develops. You'll have access to paid AI tools and training, supportive leadership and the freedom to test ideas and make decisions without unnecessary layers of sign-off.

This is a fantastic opportunity for someone who enjoys variety, wants to be trusted to get on with their job and is excited by the prospect of helping shape a modern, forward-thinking marketing function within an ambitious and successful business.

Interested?

Please apply with an up-to-date CV that clearly demonstrates your relevant marketing skills and experience, including details of the marketing platforms, systems, AI and digital tools you've worked with.

title: SEO Manager
description:
Location: Birmingham
Working Pattern: Hybrid - 3 days in the office
Salary: 35,000- 40,000, dependent on experience

The Role

We're looking for an experienced SEO Manager to join a growing digital marketing agency in Birmingham.

This is a great opportunity for an SEO professional who enjoys getting stuck into the detail of SEO strategy, technical SEO, content SEO and organic growth, while also having the opportunity to influence the wider marketing strategy.

You'll work across a small portfolio of client accounts, but a key focus of the role will be growing the agency's own organic visibility. You'll have the opportunity to test SEO ideas, improve website performance and see the impact of your work first-hand.

If you're passionate about SEO, enjoy working with clients and want to develop your experience across both agency and in-house-style SEO, this could be a great next step.

What You'll Be Doing
- Developing and delivering SEO strategies to improve organic visibility, traffic and conversions.
- Taking ownership of the agency's own SEO strategy, identifying opportunities to grow organic search performance.
- Conducting SEO audits, keyword research and performance analysis.
- Managing technical SEO, including site architecture, crawlability, indexing, redirects and other technical improvements.
- Creating and optimising SEO content, including landing pages, service pages, blogs and case studies.
- Improving on-page SEO, metadata, website copy and user experience.
- Using GA4, Google Search Console and SEO tools to identify opportunities and measure performance.
- Working with clients and internal teams to implement SEO recommendations.
- Contributing to client reporting and confidently communicating SEO results, recommendations and next steps.
- Supporting wider marketing activity with a search-first mindset, including content and social media.
- Exploring how AI search, LLM SEO and evolving search behaviour can create new opportunities.
- Sharing SEO insights, trends and best practice with the wider team.

What We're Looking For
- 3+ years of hands-on SEO experience, ideally within a digital marketing or SEO agency.
- Strong knowledge of technical SEO, on-page SEO, content SEO and SEO strategy.
- Experience working with lead generation and/or e-commerce websites.
- Previous client-facing experience, with the ability to build relationships and communicate SEO recommendations clearly.
- Experience using Screaming Frog, Google Analytics, Google Search Console, Google Tag Manager and SEO tools such as Ahrefs, SEMrush or Majestic.
- A commercially minded approach to SEO, with a focus on traffic, leads, conversions and business growth.
- Excellent organisation and time management skills, with the ability to manage multiple SEO projects.
- A genuine interest in how SEO is evolving, including AI search and LLMs.
- Strong written and verbal communication skills.

What's On Offer
- 35,000- 40,000 salary, depending on experience.
- Hybrid working - 3 days per week in a Birmingham office.
- 25 days' holiday, increasing annually.
- Birthdays off.
- Private healthcare.
- Annual wellness fund.
- Company bonus.
- MacBook Pro and an annual budget for hardware, software or accessories.
- Regular company socials.
- Excellent career progression and development opportunities.

title: Social Media Manager

title: Marketing Manager (12 month maternity cover)
description:
The Marketing Manager role combines strategic content, design and digital delivery to support Auriga's growth and brand positioning, in addition to strengthening our profile across key sectors and supporting partnership growth.

Role responsibilities will include but are not limited to:
- Marketing Strategy: Execute a comprehensive marketing strategy that aligns with the organisation's goals and objectives. This includes developing and delivering marketing plans to engage target audiences, and aligning marketing campaigns with new business development priorities, supporting growth within target sectors and helping to generate a sustainable pipeline of opportunities.
- Line management: Line-manage and develop the marketing team.
- Stakeholders: manage suppliers and external relationships. Work with internal teams, such as Client Partnerships, Service Delivery, the Senior Leadership Team, so that marketing supports the wider organisation's goals.
- Sector horizon scanning: Carry out regular horizon scanning of legislative, regulatory, policy, and funding developments in key sectors. Report the emerging risks and opportunities to inform business planning, strategy and risk management.
- Thought leadership & content writing: Respond quickly to key news, policy and funding developments by drafting timely thought leadership content, including opinion pieces, blogs, articles and LinkedIn posts. Work closely with the CEO and senior leadership team to shape their views into content, turning policy and sector news into accessible content for a range of audiences.
- Design & Branding: Oversee all Auriga brand touchpoints across digital and print, making sure they are consistent and high quality. Create design assets and materials including promotional collateral, annual and impact reports, and print materials. Work across a range of brands, including partner contracts and our parent charity, to deliver materials that meet each brand's guidelines.
- Bids & Tenders: Support the production of professionally designed submissions, presentations and supporting collateral for bids, tenders and client pitches.
- Website Management: Manage Auriga's website and selected partner websites, including content updates, SEO, accessibility and analytics, making sure each site stays current, functional and user-friendly.
- Event Management: Coordinate Auriga's attendance at sector events, conferences and exhibitions; including scoping, booking, managing budgets and logistics, and preparing stands and materials. Manage the delivery of Auriga's events and webinar series, working with colleagues across the organisation to ensure success across agreed objectives.
- Social Media Management: Manage and deliver social media strategy, planning sector-focused campaigns that build our profile with key audiences. Create content that shares industry insights, sector developments and Auriga's impact, and support thought leadership activity. Oversee and quality-assure content produced by the marketing executive, and use analytics to report on performance and refine the approach.
- HubSpot: Use HubSpot to capture interested contacts and open up partnership conversations for the Client Partnerships team, through gated resource forms and website pop-up banners, supported by email marketing and automations
- Internal Communications: Oversee Auriga's internal communications process, working with colleagues on day-to-day channel delivery. Support colleagues with drafting and proofreading, produce and design the internal newsletter, and help deliver internal celebrations, including the annual Auriga Awards.
- Budget Management: Tracking spend against budget and planned activity. Forecast upcoming costs, flag any variances early, and make sure spending delivers value and supports agreed priorities

Key Skills and Attributes:

Essential
- Degree in Marketing, Communications or a related field, or equivalent professional experience
- Substantial marketing experience across a range of functions, including developing and delivering marketing plans and strategies aligned with business goals
- Experience of line management, or of supervising and developing team members
- Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including producing timely long-form and thought leadership content
- Ability to understand policy and sector developments quickly and turn them into accessible content
- Strong design skills using Adobe Creative Suite (particularly InDesign, Illustrator and Photoshop), with a portfolio of professional print and digital work
- Strong digital marketing skills, including website management, digital marketing, analytics and social media campaigns
- Excellent organisational and stakeholder skills, with the ability to manage multiple projects, budgets and deadlines while working with senior leaders

Desirable
- Knowledge of the not-for-profit, welfare advice or financial inclusion sectors
- A background in supporting bids, tenders and proposals
- Familiarity with HubSpot or a similar CRM and email marketing platform
- Experience of event and webinar coordination
- Confidence working across multiple brand identities

The Company:

Auriga Services is a Public Benefit Entity that has been operating for 20 years and is owned by a registered charity - Evnia Charitable Trust. As a wholly owned subsidiary, Auriga is the commercial arm of Evnia. Our charity-owned status makes us as unique in the marketplace, which allows us to genuinely care about creating better and lasting impacts for vulnerable people and households in poverty.

At Auriga Services we understand the importance of supporting people through life's challenges and our responsibilities and obligations towards our customers and beneficiaries including delivering an exceptional level of service, ensuring transparency, addressing customer concerns and upholding ethical practices to create a positive and trustworthy relationship with our consumers.

title: Digital Marketing Manager
description:
SF Partners are working with a business based in Solihull who are looking for a Digital Marketing Manager to join the team on a 6 month fixed term contract
Hybrid - 2 days in the office
£65,000 FTE

What you'll be doing
- To support the growth of the direct-to-consumer propositions for the business via the development and implementation of digital marketing strategies.
- The role's key purpose is to deliver and optimise media campaigns across paid and organic search, social, display and other channels with impactful creatives and insight led approach to drive strong commercial performance.
- With our media agency the role will be managing paid media campaigns and evaluate their effectiveness based on KPIs to ensure strong continual performance and optimisation
- Developing and implement comprehensive SEO strategies, including keyword research, technical audits, content optimisation, and link-building is a key part of the role
- Creatively the role will manage the creation and delivery of assets for all campaigns working with relevant internal and external teams to ensure they work hard and are on brand.

About The Candidate:
What you'll bring to the team
- Strong education background in or at least 3 years plus practice in Marketing, Digital or related field
- Strong digital marketing experience across paid, social, SEO including significant experience of growing, optimising and improving paid media performance. Highly detail-oriented with excellent organisational skills
- Day to day experience of running paid media, SEO (content and technical) strategies.
- Relevant experience of working with agencies across digital marketing.
- Digital technology experience across GA4, GTM, Adwords and other relevant tools

title: Marketing Assistant
description:
We are recruiting for a Marketing Assistant to join a leading organisation in Solihull on a contract basis for 6 months

Salary: up to £37,000
Working pattern: Monday to Friday from 8:30 am to 5:00 pm, hybrid working 2 days in the office per week

We're looking for a Marketing Assistant to join the growing Group Marketing function, you'll be working with some super talented and creative people who love to drive the agenda but also have fun. Check out the role information and get in touch if it sounds exciting, we're looking forward to hearing from you. This is a fixed term contract for 6 months.

What you'll be doing
- Manage product changes and communications in line with agreed SLAs
- Create engaging content for customer emails and letters
- Collaborate with external partners to effectively promote products and messaging
- Support content updates across the channel maintaining brand consistency and audience appeal
- Monitor customer feedback and ensure regulatory compliance updates are implemented

What you'll bring to the team
- Passionate about Marketing with a growth mindset and desire to challenge the status quo
- Good understanding of marketing channels
- Strong written and verbal communication skills
- Highly detail-oriented with excellent organisational skills
- Curious and takes pride in their work
